Specific Heat of Water

Chemistry H · Period 3 · Jordan Kim, Aisha Patel

Purpose

To determine the specific heat capacity of water by adding a measured amount of energy to 200.0 g of water and recording the change in temperature.

Data

MeasurementValue
Mass of water200.0 g
Energy added8,180 J
Initial temperature21.4 °C
Final temperature31.4 °C

Results

Using q = mcΔT, we calculated c = 4.09 J/g·°C, about 2.2% below the accepted value of 4.18 J/g·°C. Most of the error likely comes from heat lost to the beaker and the surrounding air.

How it works

An evening with Oasis.

  1. 3:45 PM

    You get home. Pip's sitting in the notch with a little 3 next to him.

    That's what's due by tomorrow. Nothing pops up while you're at school.

  2. 4:10 PM

    You click him, and your whole afternoon unfolds.

    Homework from Canvas, your to-dos and what's playing, in one glance. Click away and it tucks back in.

  3. 5:30 PM

    You start a focus round. YouTube tries to sneak in and closes itself.

    You keep your streak and earn points toward a break you actually picked.

  4. 7:00 PM

    Pip drops down: the lab report is due at 8:30 tomorrow.

    You tap Done when it's finished. If you forget, he'll ask again later. Never after bedtime.

Features

Everything a school day needs, in one small place.

Canvas homework

Every assignment from your Canvas calendar, grouped by day and colored by class.

Reminders that get school

A heads-up the evening before, at a time you pick. Quiet during class and bedtime.

To-dos with a time

Pick when it should be done and Pip nudges you 30 minutes before.

Focus mode

Closes YouTube, Instagram and TikTok tabs while you work, and rewards you with points.

Pomodoro and timers

Focus rounds and breaks that count down right on the notch.

Ask Claude

Drag a PDF or photo to the top of your screen and it opens in a new Claude chat.

Music

Spotify and Apple Music controls with album art, one click from anywhere.

Stock alerts

Follow a few tickers and get a pop-up when one jumps or dips.

Battery and AirPods

Charge levels for your Mac and AirPods, plus a nudge to plug in or unplug.

EC feedback

Honest notes on how your activities fit the major you're aiming for.

Make it yours

Reminders at any time, your own snooze and nudges, any accent color, and Pip in seven colors.

School or Work mode

Switch to just to-dos, focus and tools when school's out.

Updates itself

New versions arrive with one click, and each one is checked with a security signature before it installs.

Pop-out windows

Drag any tab out of the notch to keep it floating over your work.

Private on screen shares

Hide Oasis from screen sharing and screenshots, so your list stays yours.

Make it yours

The most customizable productivity app you'll use.

No two students have the same week. Oasis bends to yours, so it fits what you actually do instead of making you fit it.

Reminders
Any time before a deadline, down to the minute (42 minutes? sure), plus your own snooze length, nudges and sounds.
Your day
Quiet hours for school and sleep, and the evening time Pip gives you a heads-up.
Home screen
Pick which tiles show up, make them bigger or smaller, and drag them into your order.
Focus
Which sites get closed, how long a session lasts, and Pomodoro rounds and breaks that fit how you work.
Rewards
Make your own rewards and set what each one costs in points.
Look
Any accent color, the text size you like, and Pip in seven colors.
Mode
School mode with Canvas and ECs, or Work mode with just your to-dos and focus.
Little things
Battery nudges, a menu bar icon, a quick-add shortcut, and hiding Oasis from screen sharing.

  1. 1Open Oasis.zip from your Downloads, then drag Oasis into Applications.
